fixes.helper: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs: the Performance.getMetrics clock sample is queued directly behind Fetch.continueRequest on the ordered CDP session (previously issued before it). Chromium handles the sample after the command, so a rejected command's cancellation necessarily precedes the sample, however late either message is scheduled; the earlier pre-command sample could not prove that (review of cd23597b5). The sample is not taken after the rejection is delivered, because a late-delivered rejection would then let a later live navigation excuse a live invalid id.
